name: The Pagan's Kiss
source:
Play as a mortal student mistakenly invited to a divine midsummer gathering.

Navigate branching dialogue, romantic tension, and morally ambiguous choices.

Deep affinity and alignment system that shapes each relationship and ending.

[From [url=https://thepaganskiss.itch.io/the-pagans-kiss]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
扮演一名误收请柬、意外受邀前往众神仲夏集会的凡人学生。

在分支对话、暧昧张力与道德界限模糊的抉择间周旋。

深度的好感度与阵营倾向系统将塑造每一段关系与最终结局。

[摘自[url=https://thepaganskiss.itch.io/the-pagans-kiss]itch.io[/url]]
